findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "catalog_list_tools" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: Lists all available Sage x402 tools with exact Base USDC prices, categories, direct HTTP endpoints, example inputs, and free preview URLs. Use first to discover…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Read-only tool requests dangerous parameters
findings.detail: Tool "ai_code_security_review" appears informational but accepts parameters (code) that enable code/file/secret access.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow.
